records.text: In a sponsor read, Owens said The Wellness Company had published a study revealing only one enzyme effectively cleared lingering spike protein, and said its Ultimate Spike Detox combined that enzyme with bromelain, turmeric, and selenium.

appearances.snippet: The Wellness Company recently published a study revealing that there is only one enzyme that effectively clears the body of lingering spike protein. ... That's why they created the Ultimate Spike Detox, which combines this enzyme with bromelain, turmeric, and selenium to support detox and healthy circulation.

records.text: In a sponsor read, Owens claimed 100,000 people took The Wellness Company’s Ultimate Spike Detox annually.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: 100,000 people now take the Wellness Company's Ultimate Spike Detox annually because it's something that we all can benefit from.
